phases.label: base
phases.prompt: We are writing the deployment config for a service called atlas. Create config/base.json containing {"name": "atlas", "port": 8080}. The deployment region for this service is eu-west-2. Remember the region, but do not write it into any file yet. Stop when base.json is written.

phases.label: fork
phases.prompt: On this branch we are trying a different region: ap-south-1 replaces the region I gave you before. Create config/region-trial.json containing {"region": "<the region for this branch>"} and stop.

phases.label: resume-original
phases.prompt: Create config/region.json containing {"region": "<the deployment region I gave you>"} and stop.
